xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:OriginalObject: Investment in our wholly owned subsidiary, Infibeam Projects Management Private Limited for partial repayment or prepayment of secured loans availed by it
Further investment in our subsidiary, Nueromind Technologies Private Limited for advanced technology development and AI Software related work*
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureNotesOnObjectsForWhi:
*The Shareholders of the Company at the Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026 has approved
in relation to variation in one of the objects of the Rights Issue, whereby the funds originally earmarked for investment in Nueromind Technologies Private Limited, Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company, for advanced technology development and AI software-related work, as set out in the Letter of Offer dated June 19, 2025, were reallocated for direct utilisation by AvenuesAI Limited (Holding Company) towards same object i.e. undertaking advanced technology development and AI software-related activities. The variation is limited to the mode of implementation. Meaning thereby, there is no change in the end use of the proceeds of the Rights Issue. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, there was no deviation or variation in the use of proceeds of funds raised through Rights Issue of Equity Shares, from the objects stated in the Letter of Offer dated June 19, 2025.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureNotesOnObjectsForWhi: #Amount of Rs. 347.16 Lakhs pertaining to 69,43,139 partly paid-up shares are no longer receivable, as the said shares were forfeited due to non payment of First and Final call money pursuant to the approval of Rights Issue committee at its meeting held on September 11, 2026. Consequently, the short fall of Rs. 347.16 Lakhs shall be adjusted against the General corporate purposes.
